requirements.action: Remove blora-card/data-size from page section wrappers; add blora-stack blora-stack--lg. Keep cards only for metrics/resources/content that do not contain cards or tables.
For any ancestor of a table or dynamic table host remove Card classes; add blora-table-wrap only to the immediate table scroll host, table.blora-table.
Add official blora-grid. Metrics use blora-stat with blora-stat__label/value/suffix; keep original value IDs.
Apply class replacement to DOM AND app.js dynamic templates; preserve textContent update IDs.
After class replacement retain blora-button ghost and official icon; no legacy surface classes.

Use blora-field label/hint with adopted native input/textarea. Field does not adopt blora-select: put labelled selects in blora-stack--sm with a blora-text-muted caption and matching aria-label; do not use Field internal classes or generate a phantom input. Preserve original controls/IDs.
Remove outer Card when session cards are children; timeline metadata uses official descriptions/list/code and badge roles, not nested cards.
Replace legacy surface classes using mapping; use one-level blora-card or blora-stat as appropriate.

Existing loading branches render official spinner/skeleton, successful zero records render blora-empty, failed fetches render blora-alert variant=danger; do not disguise errors as empty or mock feedback.
